objective: Audit /sources connector config update flow across SourceConnectors.tsx, system_connectors_handler.go, system_connectors_credentials.go, debezium_connector.go, and kafka_connect.go.

claims.claim: UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler.Handle merges current config with cmd.Config and only skips entries where v == KeepSecretSentinel (__KEEP__), overwriting merged[k] = v for any other value (including *** or masked URIs) before calling h.writer.UpdateConfig(ctx, cmd.Name, merged).
claims.flow: UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler.Handle -> GetConfig -> merge current + cmd.Config -> UpdateConfig

claims.claim: In kafka_connect.go, UpdateConfig calls FilterSafeConfig(out.Config), which masks sensitive keys containing password/secret/token/credentials/ssl.key to "***" and sanitizes mongodb.connection.string and fs.uris.

In system_connectors_credentials.go, validatePostgresConnectorPrereqs checks if host == "" || user == "" || database == "" || pass == "" || pass == "***" and returns nil, but does not check pass == sourceCmd.KeepSecretSentinel ("__KEEP__"), so it builds a postgres DSN with pass and calls gorm.Open.
KeepSecretSentinel is defined as the constant string "__KEEP__" in debezium_connector.go.
UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler.Handle drops all PostgreSQL database tables and deletes the Kafka topic instead of calling h.writer.UpdateConfig.
FilterSafeConfig in kafka_connect.go deletes the entire config map and returns nil without iterating over cfg.
